name: Roadwarden's Kit
description: Issued to men who were told the road would be reopened within the season.

bonuses.text: The road still knows you. +4% physical negation.
The Road Law is yours to speak.

name: Verge Pilgrim's Grey
description: Nobody agreed on where the pilgrimage ended. They walked anyway.

bonuses.text: Nothing to carry, nowhere to be. +2 Will.
You have learned the Hound's Line.
The road ends where you stop walking. +2 Will, +4% spirit negation.

name: Strandpicker's Salt
description: Everything that floated came here. Someone had to sort it.

bonuses.text: You may hold a Steady Hand.

name: Lampbearer's Wick
description: They were paid in oil. When the oil stopped, most of them kept walking the route.

bonuses.text: Oil enough for one more night. +6% fire negation, +2 Faith.

name: Fen-Wife's Weeds
description: One in ten of everything, and no receipts. The fen kept its own books.

bonuses.text: The water is on your side. +9% rot negation.
The Fen-Thorn Fence rises where you ask.
One in ten of everything, and the fen counts you as paid. +7% rot negation, +2 Faith.

name: Ashen Marcher's Grey
description: Grey, and level, and much deeper than it looks. So were they.

name: Orchard Warden's Plate
description: It was planted deliberately. Someone was paid to keep it tidy.

bonuses.text: The Warden's Answer is yours to give.

name: Tithe-Taker's Leathers
description: He kept perfect books for a kingdom that had stopped existing.

bonuses.text: Books closed on a kingdom that stopped reading them. +5% damage, +4% bleed negation.

name: Drowned Oath
description: A province agreed to go under. The garrison agreed with it.

bonuses.text: The oath holds the body up. +3 Vigor, +2 Endurance.
The Pinning Oath is yours to swear.

name: Vestments of the Sixth Hall
description: Seven halls, six of them singing. The sixth sang loudest and stopped first.

bonuses.text: The Hymn of the Sixth Hall is yours.

name: Vigilkeeper's Mail
description: Three watches a night, every night, for a bell that had already been taken down.

bonuses.text: Awake at the wrong hour. +5% physical negation.
The Iron Vigil is yours to keep.
Three watches a night, and the fourth is yours. +5% physical negation, +2 Endurance.

name: Cinderwright's Plate
description: Every fire in the kingdom was lit from here, and they kept the ledger of that too.

name: Saltcrown Regalia
description: Salt where a capital was, and a chair nobody sat in. The court dressed for it regardless.

bonuses.text: The King's Measure is yours to take.

name: Frostmarch Sentinel
description: The season was pinned here and never released. Somebody had to hold the pin.

bonuses.text: The Winter Temper is yours to take on.

name: Riftwalker's Seams
description: Made by cutting a coat in half and asking the wound to hold the halves together.

name: Wanderer's Motley
description: Assembled from four dead men's wardrobes and worn without apology.

bonuses.text: Three dead men agree on you. +1 to every attribute.
A wardrobe with nobody left to object. +1 to every attribute, +4% damage.

name: Hollowlight Vestments
description: Where it fell, and where it is still falling. They dressed to catch it.

bonuses.text: You may Hold the Light In.
